title: Historic Limoges town hall engulfed in flames amid protests in France
content: Limoges town hall, a 143-year-old building in central France, was set on fire amid unrest following nationwide protests over the cost of living.

title: Trump’s Russian diesel deal driven by ‘dubious business motives’, Latvian MEP Kols tells Euronews
